versions.content: {DRAFT} If Time Validation is enabled for a Time Base (refer to [ SWS_StbM_00464 ] , [ SWS_StbM_00465 ] ), upon invocation of StbM_<bus>SetSlaveTimingData() the StbM shall copy the content of the structure, which is passed by parameter measureDataPtr , to the next free <bus>SlaveTimingData block of the Timesync Sla ve Timing Record Table ( Table 2 ) of that Time Base. The StbM shall then shall set the value of the block element  <bus>SlaveTimingData.referenceGlobalTimestamp as TL Sync (refer to [SWS_StbM_00438] ) and  <bus>SlaveTimingData.referenceLocalTimestamp as TV Syn (refer to [SWS_StbM_00438] ). (i.e., to the value of the Synclocal Time Tuple as set by the preceding call of StbM_BusSetGlobalTime() ).
